summary: Full end-to-end testing of new Aftersales Profitability & Forecast Reporting feature (Task 8). Backend and frontend both fully working. 4/4 pytest cases pass and Playwright UI flow (login → Corporate → Aftersales Contracts → Reports sub-tab → edit labour rate & threshold → save → recompute) passes. All spec numbers match: ARR £174,480; active_contracts=2; total_12m=£1,400; AlphaCo est_claim_cost=£2,675 @ 75/hr (36.3% margin, flagged HIGH); recompute to £3,890 @ 120/hr; expiring_soon length 2; 12 month rows rendered as proportional bars. PPM cases correctly excluded. Settings persisted and reset to defaults (75.0/0.5) after tests.
critical_code_review_comments: AftersalesApp.js is now 1777 lines — approaching split threshold; ReportsTab could be its own module for maintainability.
SUB_TABS list contains 'contracts' id but TabComp map has no 'contracts' entry (unrelated to Reports feature, existing gap).
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing report_demo seed data. Settings reset to labour_rate=75.0, high_claim_ratio=0.5 after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: GET /api/crm/v2/aftersales/reports returns forecast+high_claim as spec'd. PUT /settings accepts labour_rate & high_claim_ratio and reports recompute uses them. UI selectors used: afs-tab-reports, afs-reports, afs-reports-arr/active/total12m/flagged, afs-reports-forecast, afs-report-month-YYYY-MM, afs-reports-highclaim, afs-highclaim-row-<contract_id>, afs-reports-labour-rate, afs-reports-ratio, afs-reports-save. Save button transitions to 'Saved ✓' for ~2 seconds then reverts. Cookie banner may need dismissal ('Essential Only').
